ITEM 1 | Long thin green beans, bright to olive green with some darker charred or browned spots, glossy, slightly wilted, pieces about 5-8 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, piled loosely on the right side of the plate and draped across the dark meat | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark brown to nearly black pieces with a glossy, slightly wrinkled surface and browned caramelized edges, irregular chunks about 3-4 cm across and 1.5-2 cm tall, sitting in a cluster on the right side under the green beans | 90
ITEM 3 | Pale tan, round chickpea-like legumes, matte with a slightly bumpy surface, about 1 cm diameter, scattered among the leafy greens in the lower center of the plate, some with a faint golden tint | 45
ITEM 4 | Bright green leafy greens, flat and crinkled, slightly wilted with moist surfaces, forming a small loose pile about 6 cm across at the lower center, mixed with chickpeas and a few pale slivers | 25
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellow-tan crumbs and a few curled bits, dry and crumbly, scattered lightly near the top center of the plate | 3
